patch_description: The previous SEARCH text did not match the actual file contents. The editable region shows the current placeholder returns `rng.random((n, 2))`. This edit replaces that placeholder with a deterministic multi-start greedy hill-climbing solver: precompute all 286 triangle index triples, compute the minimum area vectorized with cross products, then run seeded multi-start local search with decaying perturbation step sizes, accepting only strict improvements, followed by a fine polish phase. Points stay in the unit square (convex, unit area), so the minimum triangle area equals the normalized score. All randomness flows from a fixed seed, so results are reproducible, and the objective itself prevents near-collinear or duplicate degeneracies.
